newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline off lows but gains sideline buyers.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline off lows but gains sideline buyers.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline prices recovered some of their early losses on Tuesday to end steady with firmer NYMEX unleaded futures improving sentiment in late trade.
Cargo trade was thin, but the gains on NYMEX unleaded futures saw traders more optimistic about arbitrage options.
"It's not as attractive as last week, but I think some people will make it work," one trader said.

Weaker prices in early business continued to fuel good barge buying interest with trade seen at $207 to a Rotterdam refiner, but the prices rises sidelined spot and paper market buyers later and left barge and swaps trade thin.
